headline.zh: Meta 聯手 Apple 釋出開源權重多模態 MoE 模型 Muse Spark Open，支援 MLX 本地推論
headline.en: Meta Teams Up with Apple to Release Muse Spark Open, a Frontier Open-Weight MoE Run via MLX

detail.zh: Meta 正式發布開源權重的前沿多模態混合專家（MoE）模型 Muse Spark Open，並與 Apple 深度合作優化 MLX 框架。官方宣稱這是同級別中首個可直接在兩台 Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studio 桌面環境上順暢運行的頂級開源模型，大幅降低本地部署前沿多模態架構的硬體門檻。
detail.en: Meta has released Muse Spark Open, an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model optimized with Apple for the MLX framework. Meta claims it is the first frontier model in its tier capable of running locally across two Mac Studio setups, significantly lowering the desktop deployment barrier for top-grade multimodal architectures.

headline.zh: Anthropic IPO 前夕向投資人揭露財報：Q3 營收季增近五成達到 168 億美元
headline.en: Anthropic Discloses $16.8B Q3 Revenue to Investors Ahead of Anticipated IPO

detail.zh: 根據金融時報報導，Anthropic 在投資人日揭示亮眼業績，營收從 Q1 約 48 億美元狂飆至 Q3 的 168 億美元，單季成長接近 50%。數據顯示其運算效率大幅提高，Q3 每投入 1 美元算力成本即可產生 1.7 美元營收，顯示大模型商業化變現速度超乎預期。
detail.en: According to reports from its investor day, Anthropic's quarterly revenue surged from $4.8B in Q1 to $16.8B in Q3, marking nearly a 50% jump. Notably, the company revealed an efficiency milestone of generating $1.70 in revenue for every $1 spent on computing power, pointing to rapid monetization ahead of its IPO.

headline.zh: FTC 針對 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 展開資安調查，釐清事件通報與用戶損害狀況
headline.en: FTC Probes Anthropic and OpenAI Over Past Security Incidents and Timely Reporting

detail.zh: 美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）正調查 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 先前發生的資安與隱私事件是否損害消費者權益。監管機構正聚焦這兩大前沿模型開發商在遭遇安全事故時的揭露時程，若被認定延遲通報，可能面臨等同重大資料外洩案的巨額罰款。
detail.en: The FTC is scrutinizing Anthropic and OpenAI to determine whether recent security and privacy incidents caused consumer harm. Regulators are closely examining the timeliness of data breach disclosures by frontier AI labs, with potential fines matching those imposed on major tech data breach violations.

headline.zh: FLUX.3 Image Klein 正式整合進 Hugging Face Diffusers 函式庫
headline.en: FLUX.3 Image Klein Officially Integrated into Hugging Face Diffusers

detail.zh: 新一代生圖模型 FLUX.3 Image Klein 已登陸 Hugging Face Diffusers，開發者可透過標準 pipeline 呼叫最新權重。該版本大幅提升了文生圖的細部紋理與指令遵從度，社群已可直接套用現有 LoRA 與推論優化工具鏈。
detail.en: The FLUX.3 Image Klein generative image model is now available directly within the Hugging Face Diffusers library. Developers can access the pipeline with standard workflows, bringing noticeable improvements in prompt fidelity and detail rendering along with native ecosystem tool support.

headline.zh: IBM 發布 Granite Switch 4.1：整合對話、決策路由與語音的全合一端點
headline.en: IBM Releases Granite Switch 4.1: Unified Endpoint for Chat, Routing, and Speech

detail.zh: IBM 發布 Granite Switch 4.1，將文字對話、複雜任務分流決策（Routing）與語音辨識/合成整合至單一 API 端點。此設計旨在解決多代理人（multi-agent）架構中因呼叫多個分散服務產生的延遲與通訊開銷，為企業級工作流提供極高吞吐。
detail.en: IBM has introduced Granite Switch 4.1, packaging chat, intelligent decision routing, and speech processing into a single API endpoint. This design reduces serialization overhead and network latency commonly seen in distributed multi-agent systems, boosting enterprise workflow efficiency.

headline.zh: Apertus 1.5 釋出：強化多語言能力與開放模型架構
headline.en: Swiss AI Consortium Drops Apertus 1.5 Release Notes

detail.zh: 瑞士 AI 團隊釋出開源語言模型 Apertus 1.5 版本更新，針對長文本推理上下文及歐系多語言理解進行了深度對齊微調。隨附的技術日誌公開了完整的數據清洗管線與權重設定，持續推進高透明度的開源模型生態。
detail.en: The Swiss AI team published release notes for Apertus 1.5, delivering improvements to long-context reasoning and multilingual parsing across European languages. The update includes transparent datasets and evaluation pipelines, advancing verifiable open-source AI development.

headline.zh: ChatGPT Chrome 擴充功能升級：支援直接讀取並關聯目前已開啟分頁
headline.en: ChatGPT Chrome Extension Can Now Inspect and Use Open Browser Tabs

detail.zh: 在終止獨立瀏覽器專案後，OpenAI 升級了 ChatGPT 的 Google Chrome 擴充功能。使用者在 Web 或桌面端呼叫 @Chrome 標籤時，模型即可直接獲取當前分頁的 DOM 與文字內容進行分析，為日常文獻整理與程式碼排錯提供流暢的 context 注入路徑。
detail.en: Following the sunset of its standalone browser initiative, OpenAI upgraded the ChatGPT Chrome extension to ingest active browser tabs. Users can mention Chrome in web or desktop chats to let the LLM directly analyze tab context, streamlining code debugging and reading workflows.

headline.zh: Figma 發表全新 Agent 框架與 Code Layers 公開測試版
headline.en: Figma Launches Agent Integration Protocols and Code Layers Beta

detail.zh: Figma 推出針對自主 AI 代理人設計的互動機制，定義了外部 agent 操作畫布與讀取設計結構的標準規格；同時開放「Code Layers」公開測試，使設計圖層能即時雙向同步至前端程式碼結構，大幅拉近設計與開發者之間的溝通鴻溝。
detail.en: Figma introduced new platform protocols defining how autonomous AI agents interact with canvas data, alongside an open beta for 'Code Layers.' The feature enables bi-directional synchronization between UI components and codebases, tightening the feedback loop for developers.

headline.zh: Bluesky 擴充 AI 工具 Attie：支援「社交 vibe coding」直接生成微型 App
headline.en: Bluesky Expands Attie AI to Enable Social Vibe Coding for Interactive Apps

detail.zh: Bluesky 將其內部 AI 實驗項目 Attie 全面擴展，使用者可透過自然語言提示詞直接生成小遊戲、投票與儀表板等網頁應用，並直接嵌合於社交動態中分享。這展示了輕量級應用由社群平台原生 prompt 即時生成的「vibe coding」落地場景。
detail.en: Bluesky expanded its experimental Attie tool to support 'social vibe coding,' letting users generate interactive web mini-apps, quizzes, and games via prompts. These applications can be published instantly into the network feed, showcasing low-barrier generative client development.

headline.zh: Google DeepMind 發表 Google Antigravity 平台，加速抗微生物肽篩選
headline.en: Google DeepMind Unveils Antigravity to Accelerate Antimicrobial Discovery

detail.zh: DeepMind 公開科學專案「Google Antigravity」，結合生成式幾何神經網路與蛋白質構型預測，專門用於高通量篩選新型抗微生物肽（AMP）。該架構能有效預測候選分子的殺菌活性與生物毒性，解決耐藥性病原體研發週期過長的問題。
detail.en: DeepMind introduced 'Google Antigravity for Science,' a framework combining generative geometric learning with structural protein prediction to discover novel antimicrobial peptides. The system dramatically speeds up the candidate screening pipeline while predicting bacterial toxicity profiles.

headline.zh: OpenAI 推出 Rosalind 學術計畫：提供專案補助與生科專用模型 GPT-Rosalind
headline.en: OpenAI Introduces Rosalind Academic Plan to Fund GPT-Rosalind Bio Labs

detail.zh: OpenAI 宣布推出 Rosalind Academic Plan，鎖定具資格的生命科學實驗室提供全額資助的專用模型 GPT-Rosalind 及專用 API 配額。該模型針對分子生物學、蛋白質折疊與基因序列分析進行深度專業微調，推動 AI 輔助生科研究普及。
detail.en: OpenAI announced the Rosalind Academic Plan, granting academic bio labs sponsored access to its domain-specific GPT-Rosalind model and API credits. Fine-tuned on molecular chemistry and genomic sequences, the system is tuned to support complex biological synthesis workflows.

headline.zh: Anthropic 開放 METR 研究人員內部系統存取權以進行獨立安全審查
headline.en: Anthropic Grants METR Researchers Direct Access for Third-Party Safety Audits

detail.zh: Anthropic 採取前所未有的安全評估舉措，賦予獨立評估組織 METR（前身為 ARC Evals）等同內部員工的系統存取權。該協議承諾 METR 有權自主公開發布針對潛在風險與災難性危害的模型評估報告，且 Anthropic 無權干預審查結果。
detail.en: Anthropic has granted researchers at METR employee-level internal access to conduct rigorous safety audits. Crucially, Anthropic waived its right to pre-approve or veto findings, allowing METR to independently disclose evaluations regarding dangerous autonomous capabilities.

headline.zh: Simons 基金會注資 1,500 萬美元，協助數學研究界應對 AI 時代衝擊
headline.en: Simons Foundation Launches $15M Initiative for Mathematics in the AI Era

detail.zh: 數學與物理頂級贊助機構 Simons Foundation 啟動一項高達 1,500 萬美元的專項基金，支持理論數學家整合形式化證明助手（如 Lean）與神經網路。該計畫目標在於探討 AI 輔助證明是否會重塑現代數學的研究方法論與同行評審機制。
detail.en: The Simons Foundation has committed $15M to help mathematicians integrate formal proof assistants like Lean with modern AI systems. The program aims to explore how automated formalization will reshape pure mathematical discovery and peer review processes.

headline.zh: Ricursive Intelligence 獲注目：利用自疊代 AI 自動化設計下一代運算晶片
headline.en: Ricursive Intelligence Emerges to Tackle Compute Bottlenecks with AI-Designed Chips

detail.zh: 新創公司 Ricursive Intelligence 披露其自動化半導體架構，利用具自我學習能力的強化學習代理人進行晶片電路布局與微架構設計。透過每代硬體執行數據回傳持續優化下一代 layout，力求突破傳統 EDA 工具耗時漫長的瓶頸。
detail.en: Startup Ricursive Intelligence revealed its AI-driven chip design methodology, utilizing self-improving agents to automate physical synthesis and microarchitectures. By feeding operational metrics into iterative designs, the firm seeks to speed up tape-out cycles beyond legacy EDA tooling.

headline.zh: YouTube Music 正式上線生成式 AI 音樂標籤功能，協助聽眾辨別純人類與合成作品。
headline.en: YouTube Music begins rolling out granular generative AI disclosure labels on tracks.

headline.zh: Sega 因 AI 升頻瑕疵與技術問題下架《幕府將軍 2》高畫質復刻版。
headline.en: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from stores following backlash over flawed AI upscaling.

headline.zh: 微軟展示針對 Windows 最佳化的 RTX Spark 筆電平台，強化端側 AI 推論管線。
headline.en: Microsoft details OS-level optimizations for Nvidia's RTX Spark platform for local laptop inferencing.

headline.zh: 亞馬遜硬體負責人預測未來情境式環境 AI 將徹底取代獨立 App 操作介面。
headline.en: Amazon devices head Panos Panay argues ambient AI agents will soon deprecate discrete applications.
